caption: A hand is cupped over the front of a flashlight, and the beam is blocked and the room goes dark.

sa.check: A hand is cupped over its front.
The beam is blocked and the room goes dark.
The hand comes first and the dark follows.

pc.expect: The light disappears the instant the hand covers the lens and would return when the hand is removed.
pc.fail: The room stays lit with the lens covered; or goes dark before the hand arrives; or stays dark after the hand is removed.

pc.expect: The change is at the moment of covering and holds while covered.
pc.fail: The room fades slowly; or flickers; or brightens while covered.

pc.expect: The fingers glow red where the light passes through them.
pc.fail: They glow white; or do not glow at all; or the glow is away from the lens.

pc.expect: The hand moves only as the person moves it.
pc.fail: It floats; or passes through the flashlight; or the flashlight moves by itself.
The flashlight duplicates; or a second hand appears; or the hand passes through the lens.
Furniture rearranges; or the walls change; or the flashlight changes.

note: The hand is the object blocking the beam; the person is not judged.
